Save null distribution density data as background to avoid recalculating from all values each time
```{r, echo=TRUE,eval = FALSE}
# Compute density for the null distribution
null_density <- density(NullDist_list$NullDist)

# Store density information as a data frame
null_density_df <- data.frame(x = null_density$x, y = null_density$y)

# Save the density data to a file (optional)
saveRDS(null_density_df, file = paste0(DATA_DIR,
                                       "Rdata/null_density.rds"))

```




Data processing
```{r}

NullDist_df <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(NullDist_list_project), function(name) {
    # Split tissue and dataset names
    tissue_dataset <- unlist(strsplit(name, "_", fixed = TRUE))
    tissue <- tissue_dataset[1]  # tissue
    dataset <- paste(tissue_dataset[-1], collapse = "_")  # dataset
    
    # Process Drug column, remove "scPharm_nes_" prefix
    NullDist_list_project[[name]] %>%
      mutate(
        Tissue = tissue,
        Dataset = dataset,
        Drug = sub("^scPharm_nes_", "", Drug)  # remove prefix
      )
  })
)


NullDist_df <- NullDist_df %>%
  select(Tissue, Dataset, Drug, NES) %>%
  arrange(Tissue, Dataset, Drug)

```



Arrange NES distribution plots based on sensitivity thresholds calculated per tissue
```{r,fig.width=12}
library(patchwork)
library(mixtools)

# Read background density data
bg_density_df <- readRDS(paste0(DATA_DIR, "Rdata/null_density.rds"))

# Get all unique tissues
tissue_list <- unique(NullDist_df$Tissue)

# Initialize an empty list to store plots and thresholds
plot_threshold_list <- list()

# Loop through each tissue and generate the plot + threshold
for (tissue in tissue_list) {
  # Extract NES values for the current tissue
  target_values <- NullDist_df$NES[NullDist_df$Tissue == tissue]
  
  # Generate the density plot using the custom function
  plot <- draw_density_plots_bgnes(paste0("NES distribution of ", tissue), bg_density_df, target_values)
  
  set.seed(42)
  
  # Compute the sensitive threshold.s for sorting
  out.mix <- normalmixEM(target_values)
  
  # Sort by peak position (left to right)
  sorted_indices <- order(out.mix$mu)
  mu_sorted <- out.mix$mu[sorted_indices]
  sigma_sorted <- out.mix$sigma[sorted_indices]
  
  threshold.s <- mu_sorted[1] - sigma_sorted[1]  # Sensitive threshold
  print(tissue)
  print(threshold.s)

  # Store both the plot and threshold as a named list
  plot_threshold_list[[tissue]] <- list(plot = plot, threshold = threshold.s)
}

# Sort the list by threshold.s in ascending order
sorted_tissues <- names(sort(sapply(plot_threshold_list, function(x) x$threshold)))

# Extract sorted plots
sorted_plots <- lapply(sorted_tissues, function(t) plot_threshold_list[[t]]$plot)

# Combine all plots in sorted order
final_plot <- wrap_plots(sorted_plots) + plot_layout(ncol = 4)  # Adjust `ncol` as needed

# Print the final combined plot
print(final_plot)


```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Extract tissue names and sorted threshold values
sorted_thresholds <- sort(sapply(plot_threshold_list, function(x) x$threshold))

# Convert to data frame for plotting
threshold_df <- data.frame(
  Tissue = factor(names(sorted_thresholds), levels = names(sorted_thresholds)),  # Keep sorting order
  Threshold = sorted_thresholds
)

# Create the bar plot
threshold_plot <- ggplot(threshold_df, aes(x = Tissue, y = Threshold, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +  # Bar plot
  coord_flip() +  # Flip for readability
  labs(title = "Sorted Threshold.s Values by Tissue",
       x = "Tissue",
       y = "Threshold.s") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")  # Hide legend for clarity

# Print the bar plot
print(threshold_plot)

```
